name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Reconciles live settings without polling, adds deliberate section refresh, preserves Jellyfin-owned Recently Added rows, tracks stable library identities and conservatively repairs unambiguous deleted/re-added library IDs and stale routes, validates cached media-bar source/timing/image type before display, restores My List and removal controls, and makes Top 10-50 source changes sequential and cancellable.
